# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description

## HTML Description (for `<description>` tag in plugin.xml)

```html
<h2>Dependency License Lens — Know Your Licenses Before They Become Legal Problems</h2>

<p>Scan your project dependencies for license information and identify compliance risks directly in your IDE. 
See license types inline in build files, detect conflicts, and ensure your dependency stack is legally safe.</p>

<h3>Core Features</h3>
<ul>
    <li><b>License Detection</b> — Automatically resolves licenses from Maven Central metadata</li>
    <li><b>Inline Hints</b> — License type shown next to each dependency in build files</li>
    <li><b>Risk Levels</b> — Color-coded: 🟢 Permissive, 🟡 Weak Copyleft, 🔴 Strong Copyleft</li>
    <li><b>Conflict Detection</b> — Flags incompatible license combinations</li>
    <li><b>Compliance Dashboard</b> — All dependencies grouped by license and risk level</li>
    <li><b>Build System Support</b> — Gradle (Kotlin + Groovy) and Maven</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features ($3.90/month)</h3>
<ul>
    <li>Unlimited dependencies (free limited to 50)</li>
    <li>npm/yarn/pnpm, pip/poetry, Go modules support</li>
    <li>SBOM export (SPDX and CycloneDX)</li>
    <li>Policy enforcement with allowed/denied lists</li>
    <li>Transitive dependency analysis</li>
    <li>CI integration with SARIF output</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
    <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)</li>
    <li>Project with Gradle or Maven build files</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<p>
    <a href="#">Documentation</a> |
    <a href="#">Issue Tracker</a> |
    <a href="#">Contact Support</a>
</p>
```

## Summary

**Tagline:** Know your licenses before they become legal problems.

**Short Description (200 chars):** Scan dependencies for license info, detect conflicts, and ensure compliance. Inline hints, risk levels, SBOM export, and policy enforcement. Free + Pro.
